file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW/GCC 13-win32 built, symbols stripped (external PDB), 10 sections, ImageBase 0x140000000, entry 0x140001410

injection_details.method: Process hollowing / RunPE: CreateProcessA(lpApplicationName=NULL, lpCommandLine=stack-built path, dwCreationFlags=0x4 CREATE_SUSPENDED) -> NtQueryInformationProcess(hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation=0, size 0x30) to obtain PEB base -> NtReadVirtualMemory(PEB+0x10, 8 bytes) to read the remote ImageBaseAddress -> NtUnmapViewOfSection(hProcess, imageBase) -> VirtualAllocEx(hProcess, imageBase, size, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE=0x3000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE=0x40) with a fallback to lpAddress=NULL if the preferred base fails -> WriteProcessMemory(hProcess, remoteBase, payload, 0x40) -> GetThreadContext(hThread, ctx with ContextFlags=0x10000B CONTEXT_FULL) -> ctx.Rcx = remoteBase (CONTEXT+0x80) -> SetThreadContext -> ResumeThread
injection_details.target_discovery: Hard-coded path, NOT present as a contiguous literal: assembled at runtime on the stack from four 8-byte movabs immediates (0x6f646e69575c3a43 'C:\Windo', 0x65747379535c7377 'ws\Syste', 0x686376735c32336d 'm32\svch', 0x006578652e74736f 'ost.exe\0') - classic stack-string obfuscation. No process enumeration (no CreateToolhelp32Snapshot/OpenProcess).
injection_details.payload: 64-byte (0x40) shellcode blob embedded in the .data section at VA 0x140004000; decrypted in-memory on the stack before being written to the remote process
injection_details.payload_write: WriteProcessMemory into RWX memory allocated by VirtualAllocEx in the suspended svchost.exe
injection_details.execution_trigger: Thread context hijack - entry argument register RCX set to the allocated remote base, then ResumeThread
injection_details.cleanup_on_failure: VirtualFreeEx(MEM_RELEASE=0x8000), TerminateProcess(hProcess, 0), CloseHandle(hThread/hProcess) on every error path (fails silently, returns -1)

encryption_details.algorithm: Two-layer symmetric decryption of the injected payload: (1) repeating-key XOR with a 10-byte key, then (2) RC4 (standard 256-byte KSA/PRGA implemented inline at 0x1400014ef and 0x1400015e2) with a 16-byte key. Encryption order was therefore RC4-then-XOR.
encryption_details.key: XOR layer key (10 bytes, .rdata:0x140005000): DE AD BE EF 13 37 CA FE BA BE ; RC4 layer key (16 bytes, .rdata:0x140005010): 'Hollowing_PE!!!!' (48 6F 6C 6C 6F 77 69 6E 67 5F 50 45 21 21 21 21)
encryption_details.key_storage: Both keys are stored in plaintext as hard-coded constants in the read-only .rdata section (0x140005000 and 0x140005010) and passed by pointer to the decryption routines; no key derivation, no runtime key generation.

decoded_strings.dynamically_resolved_apis: NtQueryInformationProcess, NtUnmapViewOfSection, NtReadVirtualMemory (resolved via GetModuleHandleA+GetProcAddress, not imported)
decoded_strings.payload_after_xor_layer_before_rc4: 5571757565617047 67b29cf4c8f068d2 8a33030eeb908508 a0367d87ef70bfc9 e6d78f2f6fd58dd2 f5614c961eb1e0fc 044c4ae2df9b2339 b39b0804c3b173 (64 bytes; second RC4 layer with key 'Hollowing_PE!!!!' yields the final 64-byte shellcode, which is non-ASCII binary)
decoded_strings.note_on_final_payload: Final plaintext is a 64-byte binary shellcode stub; it contains no readable strings and no network indicators.

anti_analysis: Anti-debug via ntdll!NtQueryInformationProcess with ProcessInformationClass 7 (ProcessDebugPort) - execution aborts if the returned port != 0xFFFFFFFF
Anti-debug via ntdll!NtQueryInformationProcess with ProcessInformationClass 0x1F (ProcessDebugFlags) - execution aborts if the flag != 0
Debug check is executed first in main; on detection the program silently returns 0 without decrypting the payload or touching the target process (no error message, no crash)
Dynamic API resolution (GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll") + GetProcAddress) so the native APIs used for hollowing do not appear in the import table
Stack-constructed strings (movabs 8-byte immediates) hide the 'C:\Windows\System32\svchost.exe' target path from static string extraction
Layered payload obfuscation (repeating-key XOR followed by RC4) keeps the injected shellcode opaque on disk
Sleep(2000) delay after injection (timing/sandbox-timeout friendly stall)
Binary is compiled stripped (symbols/line numbers removed, debug info pointed at an external PDB)
